# Homeadvisor vs Thumbtack vs Angi’s: Lead Generation Comparison

[By Brian Horwitz](https://onlinevisibilitypros.com/author/ovpadmin/ "View all posts by Brian Horwitz")[February 15, 2022](https://onlinevisibilitypros.com/2022/02/15/ "7:35 am")

![homeadvisor vs thumbtack vs angis lead generation](https://onlinevisibilitypros.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/homeadvisor-vs-thumbtack-vs-angis-lead-generation-comparison02-1.png)The U.S. market for home services was [worth $595 billion](https://www.angi.com/research/reports/market/) in 2021.

Is your home service business getting its share of this growing market?

Would you like more leads, but aren’t sure how to get them?

Home service marketplaces could be a good place to start.

HomeAdvisor, Thumbtack, and Angi’s are three of the top lead generation sites for home contractors and service professionals.

Deciding which one to use takes some research, though.

In the debate over HomeAdvisor vs Thumbtack vs Angi’s, each platform has pros and cons.

Let’s dive into the details when we compare **HomeAdvisor vs Thumbtack vs Angi’s for lead generation**.

You’ll be in a better position to decide which one lead generation strategy may best for your business.

## Using HomeAdvisor to Get Leads

HomeAdvisor is a pay-per-lead platform.

However, you also have to pay an annual membership fee to be listed on the site.

To get started on HomeAdvisor, you’ll need to set up an account.

The first step is creating your business profile.

The HomeAdvisor system will conduct a background check as well as a sex offender, civil judgment, and state license screening.

After the system approves your account, you can set your monthly lead budget.

### Types of Leads From HomeAdvisor

HomeAdvisor has two types of leads:

1.  Market Match
2.  Exact Match.

Market Match leads are shared.

They go to you and to other service providers in your area.

Exact Match leads are [exclusive leads to your company](https://onlinevisibilitypros.com/services/lead-generation/).

### How Much Do Leads Cost?

How much you’ll pay for each lead depends on several factors including:

*   Your industry
*   Types of jobs you want leads for
*   Size of the project
*   Region you work in

The cost can vary widely based on these factors.

You pay more for Exact Match leads than for Market Match.

You can use the Lead Fee Schedule tool for an estimate of what you could expect to pay.

**Important:** HomeAdvisor charges you a lead fee even if the potential client doesn’t end up choosing you to complete their project.

## Pros and Cons of HomeAdvisor

Setting up and managing your profile on HomeAdvisor is easy.

You can turn leads off to avoid wasting money when you’re not in a growth phase.

**One big downside** of HomeAdvisor is the cost.

HomeAdvisor is one of the most expensive sites to use.

Also, when you sign up for HomeAdvisor, you give them the right to use your business name for their own marketing.

They can create a business profile online in your name and point it back to HomeAdvisor.

You can help reduce this risk by creating your own online directory listings before you join HomeAdvisor.

## Using Thumbtack to Get Leads

Registration on Thumbtack is free for contractors.

You pay for leads when potential clients ask for a bid.

To start using Thumbtack, you need to register and set up your business profile.

You’ll select a category for your business and add information like your areas of service.

You’ll also need to upload a headshot and an introduction of yourself.

### Types of Leads on Thumbtack

Thumbtack offers you **exact matches** and **opportunity leads**.

An exact match is when a customer is looking for a job that perfectly matches the types of jobs you’re willing to take.

Thumbtack charges you automatically for exact match leads.

Setting your targeting preferences is very important to be sure that exact matches really fit the jobs you want to do.

With opportunity leads, you can see customers who are actively requesting quotes for services you provide.

You can reach out to the customer if a job looks interesting.

You only pay for these leads if the potential customer responds to your offer.

### Instant Match

One feature that sets Thumbtack apart is Instant Match, which is an automated lead generation tool.

Instead of replying manually to leads, you can pre-submit information about your services and pricing.

When a relevant job posting comes up, Thumbtack automatically sends a bid on your behalf.

### How Much Do Leads Cost?

Like HomeAdvisor, the cost of a lead depends on several factors including the size of the job and the number of other interested providers in the area.

If many contractors are competing for the same jobs, the price of the leads goes up.
